plugins.name: snitch
plugins.description: Is your AI-written code secure? Scans it for real vulnerabilities and proves each one with file and line evidence.

plugins.name: snitch-marketing
plugins.description: Why isn't your site ranking or converting? Audits your SEO, AI-search visibility, page speed, and how well the pages persuade, with evidence for every finding.

plugins.name: snitch-ada
plugins.description: Could someone sue you over your site, or just not be able to use it? Checks every page against the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standard, tells you which laws apply to you, and checks whether your code is ready for other languages.

plugins.name: snitch-ux
plugins.description: Will people actually use this screen? Reviews your interface and its on-screen copy for clarity and honest persuasion.

plugins.name: snitch-devready
plugins.description: Is your repo ready for an AI coding assistant? Sets up the config, commands, and permissions it needs.

plugins.name: snitch-docwriter
plugins.description: Does your writing sound like AI wrote it? Rewrites docs in plain controlled English and scores the result.

plugins.name: snitch-focusedcopy
plugins.description: Is your landing page copy in the wrong order? Restructures it around a widely taught sales-call framework and checks every claim.

plugins.name: snitch-adsready
plugins.description: Ready to run paid ads? Checks your pixels, conversion tracking, and consent setup across ten ad platforms.

plugins.name: snitch-blueprint
plugins.description: Not sure what to build, or what to charge for it? Decides your audience, pages, price, and build order — before you write code, or partway through a build nobody made those calls on.

plugins.name: snitch-storeready
plugins.description: Will Apple or Google reject your app? Audits it against both stores' submission rules before you submit.

plugins.name: snitch-cmo
plugins.description: Don't have a marketing strategy yet? Builds one from your product's real facts: who to sell to, what the price you already charge says about you, your brand story and your names. Then drafts the posts and sales copy for you to publish.

plugins.name: snitch-router
plugins.description: Not sure which skill you need? Ask this one and it points you to the right skill or flow.

plugins.name: snitch-cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare security + readiness — zone/account/Workers/Pages/Tunnel/Access posture, idempotent hardening, migration guidance.

plugins.name: snitch-aws
plugins.description: AWS security + readiness — IAM/S3/EC2/VPC/RDS/Lambda/CloudFront/CloudTrail/GuardDuty posture and hardening.

plugins.name: snitch-azure
plugins.description: Azure security + readiness — subscription/Entra/RBAC/Defender/Sentinel/storage/keyvault posture and hardening.

plugins.name: snitch-digitalocean
plugins.description: DigitalOcean security + readiness — Droplet/Database/Spaces/App-Platform/DOKS/Firewall posture and hardening.

plugins.name: snitch-flyio
plugins.description: Fly.io security + readiness — org/apps/machines/volumes/postgres/secrets/network/token posture and hardening.

plugins.name: snitch-railway
plugins.description: Railway security + readiness — workspace/project/services/env/volumes/databases/tokens/domains posture and hardening.

plugins.name: snitch-vercel
plugins.description: Vercel security + readiness — account/team/project/env/domains/deployments/protection/functions posture and hardening.
